konversationen_teilnehmer_ck.name: konversationen_teilnehmer_ck
konversationen_teilnehmer_ck.value:
("konversationen"."art" = 'family' and cardinality("konversationen"."teilnehmer") = 0)
        or ("konversationen"."art" = 'direct' and cardinality("konversationen"."teilnehmer") = 2)
        or ("konversationen"."art" = 'group' and cardinality("konversationen"."teilnehmer") between 2 and 20)

termin_ausnahmen_zeit_len_ck.name: termin_ausnahmen_zeit_len_ck
termin_ausnahmen_zeit_len_ck.value: ("termin_ausnahmen"."start" is null or char_length("termin_ausnahmen"."start") between 10 and 20) and ("termin_ausnahmen"."ende" is null or char_length("termin_ausnahmen"."ende") between 10 and 20)

termine_zeit_ck.name: termine_zeit_ck
termine_zeit_ck.value:
("termine"."ganztaegig" and "termine"."start_date" is not null and "termine"."end_date" is not null and "termine"."end_date" > "termine"."start_date")
        or (not "termine"."ganztaegig" and "termine"."start_utc" is not null and "termine"."end_utc" is not null and "termine"."tzid" is not null and "termine"."end_utc" >= "termine"."start_utc")

user_avatars_size_ck.name: user_avatars_size_ck
user_avatars_size_ck.value: octet_length("user_avatars"."data") between 1 and 524288 and "user_avatars"."width" between 1 and 1024 and "user_avatars"."height" between 1 and 1024

users_avatar_ck.name: users_avatar_ck
users_avatar_ck.value: ("users"."avatar_kind" is null and "users"."avatar_preset" is null) or ("users"."avatar_kind" = 'preset' and "users"."avatar_preset" is not null) or ("users"."avatar_kind" = 'photo' and "users"."avatar_preset" is null)
